headline: Bonbon preprint reports zero-shot molecular-interaction capabilities and prospective inhibitor hits
summary: A Nov 10 arXiv preprint from Output Labs reports Bonbon, a 1.6B-parameter model trained on about 3.2T paired protein-ligand sequence tokens. The author reports three zero-shot interaction-property capabilities and sharp gains at the largest of six tested model sizes, plus 131 dose-response-confirmed inhibitors among 213 compounds across nine targets. Bonbon ranked compounds generated by a separate method; assays were conducted by an unnamed external CRO. The reported findings are not independently reproduced, each model scale has one training run, and clinical efficacy is not established.
